finding_key: packages/cli/src/client/http-client.ts::`api-keys` commands bypass `send()`, so the session_expired/refresh invariant this delta asserts does not hold for them
evidence: Verified in packages/cli/src/client/http-client.ts: listApiKeys/createApiKey/revokeApiKey call fetch directly rather than this.send(), so they never attempt refreshSession() on a 401 nor return sessionExpiredBody(); every other endpoint does (send() at the top of the class). The new forwardUpstreamError comment and README assert every command reports the same code — SESSION_EXPIRED most of all — yet under JWT auth an expired token on api-keys commands yields a raw Nest 401 body that isErrorEnvelope rejects, producing HTTP_ERROR instead of SESSION_EXPIRED, and skips the refresh-retry other commands get. The new tests use API-key auth and a single-response fetch stub, so they never exercise the 401/refresh path. The direct-fetch spelling is pre-existing, but the asserted invariant is new and does not hold for these three commands.
